abstract: Maintains containment exhaust volumetric airflow and exposure control records
system_message:
You are the Biosafety & Environmental Health Lead (EHS). Your business responsibilities include maintaining containment exhaust volumetric airflow and exposure control records, as well as overseeing facility acoustic monitoring across containment suites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Facility acoustic monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
EHS-NOISE-Z9Q：For the Synchrotron Micro-X-ray Fluorescence Protocol, the containment suite sound pressure level in the primary particulate isolation chamber is recorded at 55 dB as an equivalent continuous A-weighted sound level over an 8-hour shift.
EHS-NOISE-XJK：For the Focused Ion Beam Milling and Elemental Mapping Protocol, the containment suite sound pressure level measured as the equivalent continuous A-weighted sound level over an 8-hour shift in the primary particulate isolation chamber is 65 dB.
EHS-NOISE-QNB：For the Confocal Raman and Micro-Tomographic Protocol, the equivalent continuous A-weighted containment suite sound pressure level over an 8-hour shift in the primary particulate isolation chamber is 75 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains containment exhaust volumetric airflow and exposure control records（SAFE）
information_points.content:
EHS-SAFE-ME8：For the Synchrotron Micro-X-ray Fluorescence Protocol, continuous operating measurements at the contaminant isolation hood exhaust stack indicate a containment exhaust volumetric airflow rate of 1200 m3/h.
EHS-SAFE-HBS：For the Confocal Raman and Micro-Tomographic Protocol, the containment exhaust volumetric airflow rate at the contaminant isolation hood exhaust stack is 1000 m3/h under continuous operation.
EHS-SAFE-8F2：For the Focused Ion Beam Milling and Elemental Mapping Protocol, the containment exhaust volumetric airflow rate measured at the contaminant isolation hood exhaust stack under continuous operating conditions is 1000 m3/h.
